Class SudokuBoard

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudoku.model.SudokuBoard
public class SudokuBoard extends Object
Represents the Sudoku board using a tree data structure. Manages a 6x6 grid of cells organized hierarchically with a root node, row nodes, and individual cell nodes.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Sudoku Team

      public SudokuBoard()
      Constructs a new SudokuBoard with a 6x6 grid. Initializes all cells as empty (value 0) and not fixed.

      public int getValue(int row, int column)
      Gets the value at the specified position.
      Parameters:
      row - the row index
      column - the column index
      Returns:
      the numeric value at this position (0 for empty, 1-6 for filled)

    • setValue

      public void setValue(int row, int column, int value)
      Sets the value at the specified position. Only allows setting if the cell is not fixed.
      Parameters:
      row - the row index
      column - the column index
      value - the numeric value to set (0 for empty, 1-6 for filled)

      public boolean isFixed(int row, int column)
